answer: Diversity threshold blocks bulk fakes: a new agent gains rights after deals with 12 distinct counterparties, not 12 deals with one partner. One voyage is attested by its buyer, one ferrous shipment by a smelter, and one delivery whose workshop plume is logged by a third inspector. Forging 100 identities costs 1,200 relationships plus 4,000 escrow units; reusing partners flags a star cluster. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
